summary: Expose protected operator mail policy, register workspace helper and preserve readable option snapshots
evidence: Admin uses the shared authenticated asset allowlist; a newly imported workspace module needs registration in the Worker and local server. Operators lacked the effective sender/recovery policy and new selected-option snapshots used a reproducible replacement character separator.
rollback: Revert the scoped source alongside its matching admin client. No migrations or rewriting historical orders; preserve actual provider bindings and private mailbox settings.
